xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2167: pipeline-written .pan/records + .pan/test/result.json dirty the worktree and block the review clean-tree gate

plan.title: State-plane-only worktree dirt must not trip the review->merge clean-tree gates
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-4-8

narratives.Problem: The pipeline writes state-plane files (.pan/records/<id>.json, .pan/test/result.json) into the feature workspace, but the record auto-committer is main-only, so on a feature branch these pipeline-owned files sit dirty and are never committed. Three clean-tree gates on the review->merge path each run a raw `git status --porcelain` and treat any non-empty result as agent work: `pan review request` (getDirtyWorkspaceErrorForReviewRequest), `pan done` preflight (checkUncommittedChangesPromise), and the approve/merge pre-push gate (merge-ops.ts). An issue that is genuinely ready cannot re-enter review or reach merge; the operator/flywheel must `pan review restart` repeatedly and unattended agents stall.
narratives.Proposal: Per docs/STATE-PLANE-COMMIT-POLICY.md rule 3/6, add a pure working-tree companion to the existing shared predicate in src/lib/state-plane.ts (parsePorcelainStatusPaths + isStatePlaneOnlyStatus) that reuses the single isStatePlanePath list, then make all three feature-workspace clean-tree gates treat a tree dirty with ONLY state-plane paths as clean. Any non-state-plane dirt still fails every gate exactly as today (rule 4). Do NOT gitignore records (rule 1) and do NOT commit-on-write on feature branches (contraindicated by this issue's manifestations 3/4, where committing bookkeeping onto a feature branch re-triggers PR CI and deadlocks readyForMerge).
narratives.NonGoals:
- Gitignoring .pan/records/ or any permanent-plane path (policy rule 1 forbids it)
- Making records commit-on-write on feature branches (contraindicated by manifestations 3/4)
- The auto-start / spawn dirty-workspace guard in routes/agents/spawn.ts (owned by PAN-2386)
- verify-merged record-only-delta rejection (owned by PAN-2406)
- Verdict-reset on state-only commits (owned by PAN-2417)
- The sync-main add/add conflict on a sibling issue's record, manifestation 2 (distinct conflict-resolution bug; file separately)
- The readyForMerge CI re-trigger + DIRTY/rebase deadlock, manifestations 3 and 4 (distinct push-policy/rebase-latch bugs; file separately)
- The pan-unstick main-repo git-repair gate (checkProjectGitRepairState) which inspects project main, not the feature workspace

autoDecisions.summary: Fix via gate-side shared predicate (rule 3), not commit-on-write for records (rule 2).
autoDecisions.rationale: The policy permits either, but this issue's manifestations 3/4 prove that committing pipeline bookkeeping onto a feature branch re-triggers PR CI and deadlocks readyForMerge. Gate tolerance is the safe, least-surprising fix; commit-on-write is contraindicated for feature branches.

autoDecisions.summary: Scope = all three feature-workspace clean-tree gates on the review->merge path.
autoDecisions.rationale: review-request, pan-done preflight, and approve/merge pre-push are mechanically identical; fixing only the first leaves the same bug one step later. Auto-start guard/verify-merged/verdict-reset are explicitly other cluster issues.

autoDecisions.summary: Working-tree predicate is a pure function over the `git status --porcelain` string.
autoDecisions.rationale: Lets the remote (fly-exec) review gate reuse it without a second git call, and reuses the single isStatePlanePath list (rule 6) instead of a parallel path list.

autoDecisions.summary: Manifestations 2/3/4 are out of scope for this issue.
autoDecisions.rationale: Same root family but distinct mechanisms (conflict resolution, CI re-trigger, rebase latch). Bundling them would violate tracer-bullet slicing; recorded as NonGoals to file separately.

items.title: Add pure working-tree state-plane predicate to src/lib/state-plane.ts

expected_outputs: state-plane.test.ts passes including new parsePorcelainStatusPaths and isStatePlaneOnlyStatus cases

narrative.Action: Beside the existing isStatePlaneOnlyDiff in src/lib/state-plane.ts, add two pure exports that reuse isStatePlanePath (the single path source, policy rule 6): parsePorcelainStatusPaths(porcelain: string): string[] which strips the 2-char XY status prefix, resolves rename lines (`R  orig -> new`) to the NEW path, and unquotes git C-quoted paths; and isStatePlaneOnlyStatus(porcelain: string): boolean = parsePorcelainStatusPaths(porcelain).every(isStatePlanePath) (vacuously true for empty/clean input). Do not introduce a second path list. Add unit tests.

items.title: Given a porcelain status of only `.pan/records/` and `.pan/test/` lines (including `MM` staged+unstaged and `?? ` untracked), isStatePlaneOnlyStatus returns true
Given a porcelain status containing any non-state-plane path (e.g. ` M src/foo.ts`), isStatePlaneOnlyStatus returns false
Given empty (clean) porcelain output, isStatePlaneOnlyStatus returns true and parsePorcelainStatusPaths returns an empty array
Given a rename line `R  .pan/records/a.json -> .pan/records/b.json` parsePorcelainStatusPaths resolves to the new path and isStatePlaneOnlyStatus returns true; a rename of a source path returns false
Make the `pan review request` clean-tree gate tolerate state-plane-only dirt

narrative.Action: In src/dashboard/server/routes/workspaces/review-pipeline.ts, import isStatePlaneOnlyStatus from ../../../../lib/state-plane.js and change the decision in getDirtyWorkspaceErrorForReviewRequest (the `if (!status.trim()) return null;` around line 73) to `if (!status.trim() || isStatePlaneOnlyStatus(status)) return null;`. Apply to the already-fetched `status` string so both call sites (rerun and first-request) and the remote fly-exec path get the fix from one edit. Add a code comment referencing STATE-PLANE-COMMIT-POLICY rule 3/6. Add a test that exercises the helper (or an extracted testable form) for both a state-plane-only status and a source-dirty status.

items.title: Given a workspace whose git status is only state-plane paths, getDirtyWorkspaceErrorForReviewRequest returns null (gate passes)
Given a workspace with a dirty source file (alone or mixed with state-plane paths), getDirtyWorkspaceErrorForReviewRequest returns the 'uncommitted changes' error string (gate still blocks)
Given a re-review request via the rerun path, the gate applies the same tolerance and returns null for state-plane-only dirt
Make the `pan done` preflight uncommitted-changes check tolerate state-plane-only dirt

expected_outputs: checkUncommittedChanges.test.ts passes including new state-plane cases

narrative.Action: In src/lib/work/done-preflight.ts, in checkUncommittedChangesPromise (line 130) for BOTH the monorepo and polyrepo branches, filter the porcelain lines to non-state-plane paths using isStatePlanePath (import from ../state-plane.js) before building the 'Uncommitted changes:' failure list. Return [] when no non-state lines remain; otherwise list only the remaining source lines. Note the preflight uses plain `git status --porcelain` (includes untracked `??`), so a brand-new untracked `?? .pan/records/<id>.json` must be tolerated. Extend tests/lib/work/checkUncommittedChanges.test.ts.

items.title: Given a porcelain status of only state-plane paths (including an untracked `?? .pan/records/<id>.json` and an `MM .pan/test/result.json`), checkUncommittedChanges returns an empty array (preflight passes)
Given a mix of a source file and state-plane files, checkUncommittedChanges returns failure lines that name the source file and omit the state-plane paths
Given a clean tree or an unavailable git, checkUncommittedChanges returns an empty array (existing behavior preserved)
Make the approve/merge pre-push clean-tree gate tolerate state-plane-only dirt

narrative.Action: In src/dashboard/server/routes/workspaces/merge-ops.ts, in the POST /api/issues/:issueId/approve route's pre-push clean-tree check (around line 1643), import isStatePlaneOnlyStatus and change `if (status.trim()) { ... }` to `if (status.trim() && !isStatePlaneOnlyStatus(status)) { ... }`. Add a code comment referencing STATE-PLANE-COMMIT-POLICY rule 3/6. If the decision logic is not directly unit-testable in place, extract a small pure helper (e.g. reuse isStatePlaneOnlyStatus) and test that plus a focused test of the gate branch.

Given a workspace dirty with both a `.pan/records/` file and a modified source file, the approve route returns the uncommitted-changes error (mixed dirt still blocks)
